PRIVATE REFLECTION: The task is to partition 22 miRNAs into three groups using PCA1/PCA2 and the raw expression profiles NonArt_1/2 vs D10_1/2 vs D21_1/2.

Evidence from the CSV:
* Seven miRNAs are essentially silenced after NonArt: D10 and D21 values are 0/near-zero while NonArt is positive. In PCA space they form a tight cloud with very negative PCA1 ≈ -15 to -20 and PCA2 ≈ +5 to +10:
miR-139-3p -19.15 / 6.51
miR-186 -18.57 / 6.12
miR-339-3p -15.58 / 4.96
miR-486 -17.19 / 9.83
miR-511 -19.75 / 5.43
miR-672 -19.88 / 5.19
mR-708 -18.25 / 8.06

This is the natural Group1 / silenced cluster. Options A, C, D list exactly this set for Group1; B and E also contain them but B/E add miR-15a and miR-485-3p to Group1 which is inconsistent with their PCA positions.

* A high overall expression / positive PCA1 cluster is visible:
miR-127 11.28 / -3.81
miR-133a 13.05 / 7.25
miR-145 15.74 / 2.48
miR-146b 4.68 / 4.79
miR-16 7.29 / 5.71
miR-221 5.56 / -3.50
miR-28 7.94 / -3.86
All have PCA1 > ~4.5 and high mean NonArt ~10-20, with maintained/increased expression in differentiation. Option C puts exactly these seven in Group2.

* The remaining eight miRNAs form an intermediate / negative PCA1 cloud:
miR-106b* -8.94 / -3.78
miR-27a* -1.93 / 3.72
miR-15a -12.28 / 0.71
miR-182 -1.45 / 1.73
miR-203 -1.82 / 2.27
miR-204 0.64 / 5.26
miR-485-3p -14.73 / -4.46
miR-224 -1.17 / -4.98
These have variable down-regulation, low-to-moderate PCA1 and mixed PCA2. Option C puts exactly these eight in Group3.

Colleague 1 and Colleague 2 both independently identify the same three clouds and map them to option C. Their arguments highlight that options A, B, D, E incorrectly mix silenced miRNAs with non-silenced, or place high PCA1 constitutive miRNAs together with the intermediate set, e.g. option A puts miR-27a*, miR-182, miR-203, miR-204, miR-221, miR-28 in Group3 with the high-PCA1 group; option B lumps miR-15a and miR-485-3p into Group1 with the silenced set; option D mixes miR-127 into Group3; option E splits the high PCA1 group.

Current belief: C is the best classification. Unresolved borderline note: miR-27a* PCA1 = -1.93 is close to zero, and miR-204 PCA1 = 0.64 is near zero, but both lie with the intermediate cloud in PCA space rather than the high PCA1 positive cloud. No disagreement among colleagues so far.
